steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: I brought him back.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: It would've been a fatal blow, but Raven's poetry book saved him in the end.
steps.female_content: It would've been a fatal blow, but Raven's poetry book saved her in the end.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: He's still alive, but can't wake up.
steps.female_content: She's still alive, but can't wake up.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Who did this?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: The Executive Officers.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: They will stop at nothing to eliminate Rustfire. The fastest way is to kill the leader. You should know best.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: I can't let them take Chief away.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: The battle isn't over yet. We still need ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Tell me, who did this?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: The execs.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: It must be them.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: The war isn't over yet. Many got infected with Mania, and many more have joined us. There's no backing out now. Julien, light the fire.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Rustfire needs a leader. Right now, this is the best leader.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Like you said, we have to take back what we lost.

<size=30>Julien stares at the cold flames in the boy's eyes and listens to the ominous noises from outside. The fleeting spark had been extinguished, and now they are faced with familiar darkness. His clenched, bloodied fist finally relaxes, landing calmly on the wheelchair armrest.</size>
The architect chuckles.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: You're right. There's no backing out now.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...There's no backing out now.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Hold a ceremony for the leader. He can't fight right now, but he can still inspire others.
steps.female_content: Hold a ceremony for the leader. She can't fight right now, but she can still inspire others.

steps.content:
Obituary

To ${PlayerName}... our dear friend, companion, and leader.

Though he fell in the pursuit of justice, 
he won us a great victory and raised our flag.

Many more will follow in his footsteps.
steps.female_content:
Obituary

To ${PlayerName}... our dear friend, companion, and leader.

Though she fell in the pursuit of justice, 
she won us a great victory and raised our flag.

Many more will follow in her footsteps.

steps.content:
We will remember this moment, remember his integrity and sacrifice, 
and remember our own anger and awakening.

Right now, our shared beliefs unite us all.
steps.female_content:
We will remember this moment, remember her integrity and sacrifice, 
and remember our own anger and awakening.

Right now, our shared beliefs unite us all.

steps.speaker: Obituary
steps.content:
We shall inherit his strength and will to fight. 
He is in each and every one of us now.
We shall take his spirit towards the goal he couldn't reach himself.

Come, let us wage war against evil and take back what we have lost!
steps.female_content:
We shall inherit her strength and will to fight. 
She is in each and every one of us now.
We shall take her spirit towards the goal she couldn't reach herself.

Come, let us wage war against evil and take back what we have lost!

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: So, they held a ceremony. News of it must've spread far and wide. A lot of people attended, right?

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: How many new recruits did Rustfire attract? Confirm the numbers, and get the intelligence department to help spread their message.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Do they know how to use “shackles” now? Excellent.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Confirm the overall M-value data for West District.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: ...Excellent.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Do they have internal disagreements about what to do next? Excellent.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Next, withdraw from West District and concentrate our forces on defending the Rust's isolation belt.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Give them two mining zones for now. It'll all be over soon.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: Evacuate the Executive Committee Headquarters in three days. Put the name list I prepared... in a file that they can crack with a bit of effort.

steps.speaker: X
steps.content: My work here is done. I wish you good luck.

After ${PlayerName} fell into a deep coma, Rustfire's thirst for revenge and combat capacity strengthened considerably.

Large numbers of like-minded people from West District joined Rustfire and threw themselves into battle.
People chose counterattacking the Executive Committee over finishing off the Corpus of BR-002 without hesitation.

The battle of vengeance ended in great victory.

On March 23rd, they occupied BR-002.
On March 25th, they defeated the remaining FAC troops and occupied BR-004.
On March 26th, they defeated the main force of Executive Officers and occupied the Executive Committee Headquarters.

On March 26th, a list of spies and large quantities of evidence were found in the Executive Committee Headquarters. The traitors who betrayed and killed ${PlayerName} were exposed. Rustfire began to purge its ranks. The bloodletting has been ongoing for three days now, and the number of deaths...
